state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`, Stage 2 (the cards), is under way: 31 of 64 listed classes carry their card.**
`Core\Arr` through `Core\Csv\Rows` in the list's order are carded and struck from
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`; `bun nv class-cards` prints
the 33 left, starting at `Core\Db`. Goal `limit-handler-reach`'s whole list is Stage 1's floor.

ADR 0203 holds the design and nothing about it is a session's to re-decide. The voice is AGENTS.md
§ *Text an end user reads*; the goal's standing decisions say what a card is and is not. The shape
every card so far uses: a `/// \`Core\X\`'s class card — \`rule:core-api/reference-card\`.` const
named `CARD` (or `<CLASS>_CARD` for a second class in the module) placed directly above the first
class's doc comment, never between a doc comment and its item, `ClassDoc` added to the module's
`use crate::registry::{…}`, and `doc: Some(&…)` on the row. `docs/reference/core/<Class>.md`'s
`summary:` is a quick source for what a class is for.
